image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) perched among dry, leafless branches against a pale, overcast sky. The bird displays glossy black plumage with visible iridescence on the neck, prominent red eyebrow combs, and white undertail coverts. Its posture is upright, gripping the branches with feathered legs.
